central_scientific_conclusion: Predictive expert information is measurably useful for forecasting routing and can improve a replay-level retention metric, but the tested reactive predictive-retention realization does not convert that information into improved end-to-end decode throughput on the evaluated runtime configuration.

unresolved_question_inherited_by_future_: How can useful predictive expert information be converted into end-to-end runtime value when reactive predictive retention alone fails to improve throughput? Possible future directions mentioned cautiously (not preregistered, not started): cost-aware retention, proactive expert movement, prefetch, compute/I/O overlap, scheduling, adaptive allocation.
